description: Send a message to the host on the guest's behalf, e.g. a question about check-in or a late arrival. Only send what the guest asked you to say. The host is emailed and replies appear in get_messages. Open from the request until two weeks after check-out.

body.description: The message to the host, in the guest's words, up to 2,000 characters.

booking_id.description: The booking the message is about.

guest_email.description: The email the booking was made with. Needed unless you connect with an agent token.

name: send_message
title: Message the host
